name: Passion fruit
description: Wrinkled shell, intensely tart pulp and crunchy seeds.

tcm.note: A new-world fruit with no classical entry; placed from its sour-cooling character.

ayurveda.note: No classical record; read as a sour tropical fruit.

histamine.note: Sharply acidic tropical fruit — the same family of triggers as pineapple and papaya.
